card.name: Numbers in mass and weight figures
card.fires_on: The space or digit/comma inside a number that is about to be followed by a mass or weight unit (kg, lbs, tons). Seen after labels like "Weight:" or in payload and biomass totals.

modes.label: Number after a mass label
modes.description: The gap or digit right after a label whose value is a mass total, such as biomass or book weight.

modes.label: Inside payload figures
modes.description: A digit or comma inside a kg-to-lbs payload figure.
